name: Ouraca
one_liner: AI-native lifelong learning and A2A community platform

team.ceo_background: Serial edtech entrepreneur, founder of FClassroom, and former CEO of ByteDance Smart Education
team.core_team: Co-founders Jundong Wu and Ximing Zhang bring Harvard Kennedy School, edtech investing, and ByteDance education platform experience

product_highlights: Dual-product ecosystem with Aibrary and Botlearn.ai
A2A collaborative community with memory sharing and persistent identity
